facts.anchor: Her knife sliced into Phil’s wrist as she was flung backwards

facts.fact: Hamish grabbed Alastor by the scruff of the neck and hauled him off Anne, tossing him aside.
facts.anchor: grab the scruff of Alastor’s neck and hauled him off Anne

facts.fact: Alastor leapt at Hamish and caught him in the chest; the two rolled through into the next room.
facts.anchor: He caught Hamish in the chest.

facts.fact: Anne pulled a long black steel blade with a ruby-and-rune hilt out of her coat.
facts.anchor: there was a long blade shining in it. It was black steel

facts.fact: Phil seized Anne around the waist just as Anne called on Gaap to transport her away.
Phil closed her bloodied left hand on the sword hilt above Anne’s hand and punched her in the stomach.
facts.anchor: Her bloodied left hand closed around the hilt of the sword

facts.fact: Anne called on Andrealphus and left as a raven that burst from her discarded trench coat and flew southwards.
facts.anchor: A raven burst from her discarded trench coat, spreading its wings

facts.fact: Jane said the bank accounts of all Anne’s aliases had been drained and reported to the Inland Revenue and police.
facts.anchor: all of those names have had their bank accounts drained

facts.fact: Anne Bredon was the school’s former Latin teacher.
facts.anchor: The erstwhile Latin teacher smiled nastily

facts.fact: Alastor addresses Phil as “Mistress”, his summoner/bond-partner.
Anne was privately tutored by her master Blaise, in contrast to Phil’s degree from Dom-Daniel.
facts.anchor: private tuition of my master Blaise

facts.fact: Phil holds a paid post at Grayne’s school (“Since I took the job”).
facts.anchor: ‘Since I took the job,’ Phil gasped.

facts.fact: Jane lists “half a dozen other names” among Anne’s aliases.
Phil compares her exhaustion to running “a five-mile steeplechase”.
Two suitcases of explosives remain in the cellars.
